bio.text: Todd Achilles is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Idaho in 2026, running against Republican Sen. Jim Risch.

He represented a Boise district in the Idaho House of Representatives as a Democrat, having been appointed by Gov. Brad Little in February 2024, and left the Legislature in 2025 to run for the Senate.

He told the Spokesman-Review that he was born in Oregon, served as an Army tank commander from 1992 to 1995, earned a business degree from the University of Washington, and worked as an executive at T-Mobile and Hewlett Packard.
